entities.name: Negotiated IMSI offset
entities.description: Information element included by the network when paging timing collision control is supported and the MUSIM UE has included the Requested IMSI offset IE.

entities.name: Requested IMSI offset
entities.description: Information element included by the MUSIM UE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request tracking area update.

entities.name: Network supports paging timing collision control
entities.description: Condition that the network supports paging timing collision control.

entities.name: MUSIM UE included Requested IMSI offset IE
entities.description: Condition that the MUSIM UE has included the Requested IMSI offset IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains the Requested IMSI offset IE when sent by MUSIM UE.
Inclusion of Negotiated IMSI offset IE is guarded by the condition that network supports paging timing collision control.
Inclusion of Negotiated IMSI offset IE is guarded by the condition that MUSIM UE included Requested IMSI offset IE.
